title: Spicy Kenyan Sausage Stir Fry
description: A Thai-inspired stir fry featuring Kenyan sausages, densely packed with flavor and spice. Serve over a bed of huge, fluffy rice.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large bowl over medium-high heat.
Add the Thai chili peppers and cook for 1 minute.
Add the onion and cook until it starts to brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the bell pepper and cook until it's tender, about 4-5 minutes.
Add the Kenyan sausages and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the Thai red curry paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the diced tomatoes and cook until the sauce has thickened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the briny fish sauce and chopped cilantro.
Serve the sausage mixture over a bed of huge, fluffy rice.
Cook the rice according to package instructions.
